### 🧪 NetSpeedTray 2.2.0-rc.4

What you found in rc.3, mostly multi-monitor. Thanks for testing!

**Prereleases don't update in-app, and WinGet and the Store won't offer this one.** Download Setup.exe or the portable zip below and install over rc.3, any earlier 2.2 prerelease or 2.1.7. If you're on a 2.2 prerelease, the running app closes itself and comes back. Your history and settings carry over.

### What's fixed since rc.3

- **Second monitors at a different scale work.** With the preferred monitor set to one at another scale, the widget floated above its taskbar instead of docking in it. Side taskbars on such a monitor were off too. Thanks @relu616 for the report and @emgeka for the analysis.
- **The weather button and a clock with seconds are respected on every taskbar.** On secondary taskbars, and for the copies from "Show on all taskbars", the widget could sit on the weather text. It now keeps a gap, like on the main taskbar.
- **Starting the app again doesn't switch off "Hide while app buttons cover the widget"** unless the widget really was hidden at that moment. The "staying visible" notice now shows once, under its own title.
- **Stuck text color from 2.1.7.** If you'd picked a text color in 2.1.7, it no longer stays white on a light taskbar (or black on a dark one). Thanks @Angel-Informatico.
- **Bengali!** Thanks @Askeleid. The Monitor graphs stay in English for Bengali for now. Hungarian polish, thanks @cscsanaki.

### What I'd love you to test

- **Two or more monitors**, especially at different scales or with side taskbars: does the widget (and its copies) sit inside each taskbar, clear of the weather and the clock?
- **Coming from 2.1.7 with a custom text color:** is the text readable on both light and dark taskbars?

### What's next

If this one's quiet for about a week, it ships as 2.2.0 through the in-app updater, WinGet and the Store.

Found something? Comment on #373 with a support bundle (Export support bundle at the bottom of Settings). Usernames, paths and IPs are stripped from it.

Full changelog: https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/blob/main/changelog.md
